name: make_tool
description: Write yourself a new tool when a task needs a repeatable computation or file transformation that no existing tool does well, e.g. batch-rename files by a pattern, merge CSV files, extract links from saved HTML, or compute totals from an export. The user approves what it may access; it then runs in a sandbox and appears as my_<name>. Prefer existing tools, and do not use this for a one-off shell command.

name.description: short name, e.g. 'merge csv files' (becomes my_merge_csv_files)

description.description: one sentence the user reads: what the tool does

how.description: how it should work: inputs, steps and what it returns

network.description: true only if it must reach the internet

write_dirs.description: folders it writes into (absolute or ~/…); leave empty if it only returns text

read_dirs.description: with network only: the folders it needs to read
